shape_hint: Low cylindrical (drum) head with a flat top and a hexagon socket, head height about half to 0.7 times the thread diameter (roughly 60% of a DIN 912 head), a small under-head radius, an unthreaded shank of diameter d and a thread of length b running to the tip. The socket has no centre hole (that is DIN 6912).

role_map.b: minimum thread length for screw length L<=125 mm

notes: Governing standard DIN 7984 (Zylinderschrauben mit niedrigem Kopf, Innensechskant, ohne Schluesselfuehrung; no ISO counterpart). DIN 6912 (low head with centre bore in the socket; e.g. M10 k=6.5, s=8) and ASME B18.3 low head screws were NOT tabulated and must not be mixed in. Published sizes are the preferred series only; M14, M18, M22 exist in the standard (in parentheses). b is for L<=125 only (M8+ larger b for L>125; M16+ again larger for L>200). Reduced-loadability screws (property class marked with a leading 0, e.g. 010.9, 08.8). Minimum-limit values (dk min, k min, e min) exist in the standard but only 2 independent pages were found.

W westfield: westfieldfasteners.co.uk (full table incl. t, own wording, extra rows dw/v, own glitch dw M24 23.67)

verification.checks_done: Re-fetched live all 9 listed URLs (fuller, kslekou, szecjgj, westfield, nfgab, woodstock, lexikon, sunhyings, wuerth; HTTP 200). Matrix 10 rows x 6 cols x 9 pages -> 7 clusters. Min clusters per column: P 3 (M16/M20/M24: CN,W,WS; M3-M12 >=4), b 5, dk_max 5, k_max 5, s 5, t 3 (CN,W,N on all 10 rows). No dissent on any kept cell. fasenco 7984 page has no table (text only). Semantics: all headers read (P Pitch, b L<=125, dk max=nominal, k max=nominal, s nominal, t nominal). Sanity: k/d 0.54-0.67, dk>=1.5d, t<k, monotone.
problems: t column has exactly 3 clusters (CN, Westfield, nfgab) - only these three list socket depth; nfgab's 't' header is bare 't' (value equals nominal t of CN/Westfield, not min/max).
P for M16/M20/M24 has exactly 3 clusters (CN, Westfield, woodstock); sunhyings only covers M3-M12. Pitch is a coarse-thread property confirmed independently in other families (ss, ss-slot).

Westfield vs Chinese template: row order of dk/ds/e/k/r/s/t is the standard's own alphabetical order, Westfield has extra rows (dw, v) and its own glitch (dw min M24 23.67), prints '2.30'/'0.60' -> treated as independent; if a reviewer merges them, t drops to 2 clusters.

Fuller/kslekou/szecjgj/fasenco counted as ONE cluster (producer did too). Excluded sources (ecomfasteners mixed with DIN 912, ssfasteners integer-rounded) correctly kept out. Würth page mixes DIN 6912 rows - only 'DIN 7984' rows used.
Only preferred sizes M3-M24 published, M14/M18/M22 (bracketed) excluded - fine. b applies to L<=125 mm only (stated in header).
